question: Who among the following won the Singapore Formula 1 Grand Prix 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sergio Perez**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sergio Perez won the race, becoming the first Mexican driver to win in Formula 1.
 
• Charles Leclerc finished second, while Carlos Sainz Jr. finished third.
 
• Max Verstappen retired from the race with a mechanical problem.
 
• The race was held in wet conditions, making it a challenging one for the drivers.
 
• Perez started the race from pole position and led from start to finish.
 
• Leclerc made a late charge for the lead, but was unable to pass Perez.
 
• Sainz Jr. finished third after a strong drive from the back of the grid.
 
• The win for Perez was his fourth of the season and moved him up to third in the Drivers' Championship.
 
• The result also extended Red Bull's lead in the Constructors' Championship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__**Formula 1 Grand Prix **__

 
• Formula 1 Grand Prix is a motor race for single-seat Formula One cars that is sanctioned by the Fédération Internationale de l'Automobile (FIA).
 
• The races are held on purpose-built circuits and public roads around the world.
 
• The Formula One World Championship is the highest class of single-seater auto racing sanctioned by the FIA.
 
• The championship consists of a series of races held over a period of several months.
 
• The drivers and constructors with the most points at the end of the season are crowned champions.
 
• The first Formula One Grand Prix was held in 1950 at Silverstone Circuit in England.
 
• The current Formula One World Championship consists of 22 races held over a period of nine months.
 
• The races are held in a variety of countries around the world, including Australia, Austria, Bahrain, Belgium, Canada, China, France, Germany, Hungary, Italy, Japan, Mexico, Monaco, Netherlands, Russia, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Spain, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, and the United States.
